about: The page-vision model's confidently wrong heading and row-header answers from the #210 report (docs/research/vision-page-understanding.md, 'Every confidently wrong case'). Each heading case is a paragraph the model called a heading; `text` is the start of the block as reflow converts it, and `gate` the check meant to reject it (null where #222 names none). The legislation SECTION lines are scored by #223: a SECTION line that opens an amendment sentence holds no title, so the model is wrong to call it a heading. Each row-header case is a column the model called row headers; `column` counts from 0 in each table on that page. Audit p62's column 0 is left out: in reflow's table it holds the row labels, so it is no data column there, though another run's table put numbers in it.
